Package index

Reduced-form VAR

Estimation, lag selection and stability.

varm()
Estimate a reduced-form VAR by least squares
var_select()
Select the VAR lag order
stability()
Eigenvalue moduli of the companion matrix
lag_matrices()
Lag coefficient matrices

Impulse responses, decompositions, forecasts

irf(), fevd(), hd() and forecast() for VAR, BVAR and draws objects.

irf() fevd() hd() forecast()
Impulse responses, variance decompositions, historical decompositions, forecasts
normalise_to()
Normalise the impact of a shock

Uncertainty

Bootstrap and Monte Carlo draws of the reduced form.

draws()
Reduced-form parameter draws

Structural identification

Recursive, long-run, sign, zero and sign, zero-pattern, heteroskedasticity and user-supplied schemes.

id_chol() id_longrun() id_given() id_sign()
Structural identification schemes
id_restrictions()
Zero (short-run and long-run) restrictions in an A-B / Blanchard-Quah style
id_zerosign()
Sign restrictions combined with zero restrictions (Arias, Rubio-Ramirez & Waggoner 2018)
id_hetero()
Identification through heteroskedasticity (Rigobon 2003), two regimes
irf_fry_pagan()
Fry-Pagan (2011) median-target rotation

Proxy-SVAR (external instruments)

Proxy identification, bootstrap, weak-instrument robust and Bayesian inference.

id_proxy()
External-instrument (proxy) SVAR identification
proxy_fstat()
First-stage strength of a proxy
proxy_draws()
Joint residual-proxy bootstrap for proxy SVARs
varm_proxy()
Proxy-SVAR (external instrument) identification and bootstrap inference
varm_proxy_robust()
Weak-instrument-robust confidence sets for proxy-SVAR impulse responses
varm_proxy_bayes()
Bayesian proxy-SVAR on top of bvarm() draws
varm_proxy_arw() id_proxy_bayes()
Bayesian proxy-SVAR with exogeneity, relevance and sign restrictions (Arias-Rubio-Ramirez-Waggoner type)
varm_proxy_gkr()
Robust-Bayes inference for set-identified proxy-SVARs (Giacomini, Kitagawa & Read)

Bayesian VAR

Conjugate NIW (Minnesota, sum-of-coefficients, single-unit-root) and triangular (shrinkage, stochastic volatility) samplers, with diagnostics.

bvarm()
Bayesian VAR
prior_minnesota()
Minnesota / sum-of-coefficients / single-unit-root prior
prior_triangular()
Triangular-sampler priors (large BVAR, shrinkage, stochastic volatility)
volatility()
Posterior volatility paths
mcmc_diagnostics() tidy(<mcmc_diagnostics>) as_tibble(<mcmc_diagnostics>) glance(<mcmc_diagnostics>)
MCMC convergence diagnostics

Time-varying parameter VAR

TVP-VAR with stochastic volatility and its time-varying dynamics.

tvpvar()
Time-varying parameter VAR with stochastic volatility
tvp_prior()
Prior for the TVP-VAR (Primiceri training-sample calibration)
irf(<tvpvar>) fevd(<tvpvar>) forecast(<tvpvar>)
Time-varying impulse responses, variance decompositions and forecasts of a TVP-VAR
irf_path()
Response of one variable to one shock at a fixed horizon, across all dates
tvp_volatility()
Volatility paths of a TVP-VAR

Local projections

Linear, IV, joint, state-dependent, smooth and panel local projections; direct forecasts.

lp()
Local projections
lp_joint()
Local projections with joint cross-horizon covariance
lp_supt()
Sup-t simultaneous confidence bands for impulse responses
lp_state()
State-dependent local projections (Auerbach-Gorodnichenko)
lp_smooth()
Smooth local projections (Barnichon & Brownlees)
lp_panel()
Panel local projections with fixed effects and clustered errors
lp_forecast()
Direct multi-step forecasts from local projections
compare_lp_var()
Compare local-projection and VAR impulse responses

Tidy output

tidy(), glance() and augment() methods (tibbles with broom column names; as_tibble() is an alias of tidy()).

tidy(<varm>) glance(<varm>) augment(<varm>)
Tidy a VAR fit
tidy(<varm_irf>) tidy(<varm_fevd>) as.data.frame(<varm_dyn>)
Tidy impulse responses and variance decompositions
tidy(<varm_forecast>)
Tidy forecasts
tidy(<varm_hd>)
Tidy historical decomposition
tidy(<bvarm>) as_tibble(<bvarm>) glance(<bvarm>) autoplot(<bvarm>) plot(<bvarm>)
Tidy, glance at and plot a Bayesian VAR
tidy(<tvpvar>) as_tibble(<tvpvar>) glance(<tvpvar>) autoplot(<tvpvar>) autoplot(<tvpvar_path>) plot(<tvpvar>) plot(<tvpvar_path>)
Tidy and plot a TVP-VAR
tidy(<lpm>) tidy(<lp_state>) tidy(<lp_smooth>) tidy(<lp_forecast>) tidy(<lp_supt>) as_tibble(<lpm>) as_tibble(<lp_state>) as_tibble(<lp_forecast>) glance(<lpm>) glance(<lp_panel>) glance(<lp_smooth>) glance(<lp_state>)
Tidy and glance at local-projection results

Plots

autoplot() methods return ggplot2 objects; plot() prints the same figure. theme_varm() and varm_palette() style them.

autoplot(<varm_irf>) autoplot(<varm_fevd>) plot(<varm_dyn>)
Plot impulse responses and variance decompositions
autoplot(<varm_forecast>) plot(<varm_forecast>)
Plot forecasts: history and fan chart
autoplot(<varm_hd>) plot(<varm_hd>)
Plot historical decompositions
autoplot(<varm_draws>) plot(<varm_draws>)
Plot parameter draws: trace and density
autoplot(<mcmc_diagnostics>) plot(<mcmc_diagnostics>)
Plot MCMC diagnostics
autoplot(<lpm>) autoplot(<lp_state>) autoplot(<lp_smooth>) autoplot(<lp_supt>) autoplot(<lp_forecast>) plot(<lpm>) plot(<lp_state>) plot(<lp_supt>) plot(<lp_forecast>)
Plot local-projection results
theme_varm() varm_palette()
varm plot theme and palette
